theorems.name: Submission.cmc_rcc_tendsto_integral_of_ae_tendsto_superlevel
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → μ (tsupport g) < ∞ → limsup (fun j => μs j (tsupport g)) atTop < ∞ → (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))), Tendsto (fun j => μs j {x | t < g x}) atTop (𝓝 (μ {x | t < g x}))) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, g x ∂(μs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, g x ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
